# Bookkeeping Essentials

> A comprehensive Canadian tax and bookkeeping resource for self-employed business owners and small businesses seeking CRA compliance and audit-ready financial records.

Bookkeeping Essentials provides practical guidance on Canadian tax obligations, deductions, compliance deadlines, and audit preparation. The site focuses on helping self-employed professionals and small business owners navigate T2125 tax forms, GST/HST filing, payroll requirements, and CRA regulations to maintain audit-ready books and avoid common tax mistakes.

## Key Topics

- CRA Compliance
- T2125 Tax Form
- Self-Employed Deductions
- GST/HST Filing
- Audit-Ready Books
- Business Tax Deductions
- Payroll Tax Deadlines
- T4A Reporting
- Capital Cost Allowance (CCA)
- Canadian Tax Compliance
- Small Business Tax Obligations
- Tax Audit Process
- Record Retention
- Taxpayer Rights
- Non-Deductible Expenses

## Tax Compliance & Filing Deadlines

- [Canadian Small Business Tax Obligations | It's All About The Rules](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/small-business-tax-obligations.html): Guide to Canadian small business tax deadlines, rates, thresholds, and CRA compliance rules.
- [Tax Compliance for Small Business | Canadian Filing Deadlines](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/tax-compliance-for-small-business.html): Reference guide for GST/HST, payroll, income tax deadlines and CRA filing requirements.
- [GST HST Filing Deadline | Canadian Bookkeeping](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/gst-hst-filing-deadline.html): GST/HST filing deadlines and CRA requirements for Canadian sales tax reporting.
- [Payroll Tax Filing Deadlines | Canadian Bookkeeping](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/payroll-tax-filing-deadline.html): CRA payroll tax filing deadlines and source deduction remittance requirements.
- [T4A Information Slips | Subcontractor Reporting Requirements](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/t4a-information-slips.html): T4A reporting requirements and compliance guide for hiring subcontractors in Canada.

## Self-Employed Tax Deductions & Expenses

- [Self Employed Tax Deductions | Canadian Sole Proprietor](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/self-employed-tax-deductions.html): Line-by-line T2125 deduction guide for self-employed sole proprietors in Canada.
- [How To Write-off Business Vehicle Expenses | Self Employed in Canada](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/business-vehicle-expenses.html): T2125 business vehicle expense deduction guide with mileage logbook requirements.
- [Home Office Expense Deduction | Self-Employed in Canada](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/home-office-expense-deduction.html): Home office T2125 deduction criteria and CRA qualification requirements for self-employed.
- [What Meals and Entertainment Expenses Are Deductible?](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/meals-and-entertainment-expense.html): T2125 meals and entertainment expense deductibility rules and CRA compliance guidelines.
- [Cell Phones and CRA | Internet Services and CRA](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/cell-phones-and-cra.html): CRA position on cell phone and internet service deductibility for self-employed.
- [13 Non-Deductible Business Expenses For The Self-Employed](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/non-deductible-business-expense.html): Guide to 13 non-deductible business expenses and CRA tax deduction limitations.
- [What is Capital Cost Allowance (CCA)? | Common CCA Rates](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/what-is-capital-cost-allowance.html): CCA definition, rates, and T2125 depreciation strategy guidance for asset deductions.

## Audit Preparation & CRA Compliance

- [CRA Audit-Ready Books For The Self-Employed | 10 Point Checklist](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/self-employed-audit-ready-books.html): 10-point CRA audit-ready checklist and common audit issues for self-employed Canadians.
- [8 Common Tax Mistakes Self Employed Business Owners Make](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/common-tax-mistakes.html): Eight common T2125 tax mistakes scrutinized by CRA auditors and audit protection tips.
- [Understanding Tax Audits in Canada | Amending a Tax Return](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/tax-audits-in-Canada.html): Canadian tax audit process overview and tax return amendment procedures with CRA.
- [Responding to a Tax Audit Notice | Steps to Follow](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/responding-to-a-tax-audit-notice.html): Steps for responding to CRA tax audit notices and filing notice of objection.
- [What is a CRA Audit Trail | Why You Want One](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/a-CRA-audit-trail.html): CRA audit trail definition and importance for audit protection and fraud prevention.

## Record Keeping & Taxpayer Rights

- [Business Record Retention in Canada | Data Storage Considerations](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/business-record-retention.html): CRA and PIPEDA guidelines for business record retention and data storage compliance.
- [Taxpayer Bill of Rights | Insight into Small Business Rights](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca/taxpayer-bill-of-rights.html): Taxpayer Bill of Rights impact on small business obligations and CRA audit defense.

## Getting Started

- [Essential Bookkeeping Habits For Audit Ready Books in Canada](https://www.bookkeeping-essentials.ca): Homepage introducing essential bookkeeping habits for audit-ready books and CRA compliance in Canada.
